[SWS_CRYPT_20907]
⌈
The function ara::crypto::x509::Certificate::LoadSubjectPublicKey
shall instantiate the certificate’s subject public key in the provided cryptoProvider.
If the certificate does not contain the key usage extension (RFC 5280, Section 4.2.1.3),
all allowed usage flags applicable to PublicKeys shall be set (i.e., kAllowSigVerification
|kAllowKeyWrapping |kAllowDataEncryption |kAllowKeyAgreement |kAllowPlaintextEx-
port |kAllowPersist). If the certificate contains the key usage extension, AllowExport
and kAllowPersist shall be set. Additionally the following key usage flags shall be set
for each certificate "key usage":
• digitalSignature: kAllowSigVerification
• nonRepudiation: kAllowSigVerification
• keyEncipherment: kAllowKeyWrapping
• dataEncipherment: kAllowDataEncryption
• keyAgreement: kAllowKeyAgreement
• keyCertSign: kAllowSigVerification
• cRLSign: kAllowSigVerification • encipherOnly: kAllowKeyWrapping |kAllowDataEncryption
• decipherOnly: kAllowKeyUnwrapping |kAllowDataDecryption
⌋
